newsitem.title: USA: BusinessNet says units file for bankruptcy.
newsitem.headline: BusinessNet says units file for bankruptcy.

text.p: BusinessNet International Inc said Tuesday that its financial services subsidiaries Options Invest Danmark A/S and Stock Options A/S filed for bankruptcy on July 7.

The decision to file for bankruptcy followed the refusal of Finanstilsyn, the Danish securities authority, to approve the applications for legal registration and qualification of the financial services companies, BusinessNet said.
Under Danish bankruptcy laws, a court appointed trustee will liquidate the assets and dissolve both subsidiaries, the company said.
